changes: [new] Productivity tab now fills the available width on larger screens
[redesign] Plan section lays out as three columns on very wide displays
[rework] Patch notes now support tags like this one
[bug] Fixed the timer resetting when switching projects mid-session
[improvement] Faster load time for the weekly history view
[security] Tightened validation on imported JSON files
[removed] Dropped the old single-column Calendar-only view
Untagged lines still work exactly as before

_comment_tags: Changelog lines can start with a bracketed tag, e.g. "[bug] Fixed the thing".
This key is documentation only — the app never reads it, just 'version' and 'changelog' above.
Any other bracketed word -> still renders as a neutral pill, title-cased.
No brackets at all -> plain untagged line.
Tags are case-insensitive and only match at the very start of the line.
